metaDescription: Review the Magnificent Travel Terms and Conditions for important information on our services, user responsibilities, and legal guidelines.

blocks.text: Any deposit or payment received by Magnificent Travel for a confirmed travel package or service constitutes the traveler's acknowledgment and acceptance of these Terms & Conditions. The person making the reservation confirms that they have read, understood, and accepted these Terms & Conditions on behalf of all travelers included in the booking.
Each traveler must hold a valid passport with at least six (6) months' validity beyond the intended date of return, unless a different validity period is required by the destination country.

Travelers are solely responsible for obtaining all required passports, visas, travel authorizations, vaccinations, and other entry documentation applicable to the countries they intend to visit. Magnificent Travel shall not be held responsible for denied boarding, refused entry, or any additional expenses arising from incomplete, invalid, or incorrect travel documentation.
Magnificent Travel does not provide travel insurance.

We strongly recommend that all travelers purchase comprehensive travel insurance covering, at a minimum, medical expenses, emergency assistance, trip cancellation or interruption, baggage loss or delay, and personal liability.

Travel insurance is particularly recommended where cancellation charges or supplier penalties may apply and refunds are not available under these Terms & Conditions. Magnificent Travel accepts no responsibility for losses or expenses that would otherwise be covered by an appropriate travel insurance policy.

Unless specifically stated in the tour inclusions, the package price does not include gratuities for guides, drivers, hotel staff, cruise personnel, or other service providers. Tips are entirely at the traveler's discretion.

Government taxes, airport taxes, security charges, airline-imposed fees, city taxes, and any other charges imposed by local authorities or third-party suppliers are also excluded unless expressly stated as included in the package.
Unless specifically listed under "What's Included," package prices do not include, but are not limited to:

items: Any other item not specifically stated as included in the package price

blocks.text: A 50% deposit is required upon confirmation to secure all travel arrangements.
The remaining 50% balance must be paid no later than fifteen (15) days prior to the scheduled arrival date, regardless of when the reservation was made.
We accept Visa, Mastercard, and bank transfer. Credit card payments may be subject to applicable bank processing fees.
All cancellations must be submitted in writing by email.
Cancellation charges are calculated from the date on which written notification is received by Magnificent Travel.

Where applicable, refunds will be limited to amounts actually recovered from hotels, airlines, cruise companies, transportation providers, and other suppliers after deduction of any applicable administrative charges.
Domestic flights and ferry tickets are strictly non-refundable. Once issued, domestic airline tickets and ferry tickets cannot be modified, cancelled, or refunded.
Cancellation charges for land services are as follows:

items: Cancellation 30+ days before arrival: No fee.
30–21 days before arrival: 25% of the total land package
20–14 days before arrival: 50% of the total land package
13 days or less before arrival, or in case of no-show: 100% of the total package price

sections.heading: B) Group Booking Cancellation Policy (8 Travelers or More)

blocks.text: Domestic flights and ferry tickets are strictly non-refundable.
Cancellation charges are as follows:

items: 75 days or more before arrival: EUR 100 administrative fee per person
74–60 days before arrival: 25% of the total package price
59–40 days before arrival: 50% of the total package price
39–25 days before arrival: 75% of the total package price
24 days or less before arrival, or in case of no-show: 100% of the total package price
15 days or less before departure, or in case of no-show: 100% cancellation fee

blocks.text: Magnificent Travel acts solely as an intermediary between travelers and independent suppliers, including airlines, hotels, cruise companies, transportation providers, local guides, restaurants, and other service providers.

All travel services are provided by independent third parties over whom Magnificent Travel has no direct control. Accordingly, Magnificent Travel shall not be liable for any injury, illness, death, loss, damage, delay, inconvenience, additional expense, accident, or claim arising from the acts, omissions, negligence, insolvency, or default of any third-party supplier.

Magnificent Travel shall not be responsible for delays, cancellations, schedule changes, missed connections, mechanical failures, overbookings, labor disputes, strikes, riots, civil unrest, acts of terrorism, war, government actions, epidemics, pandemics, quarantines, adverse weather conditions, natural disasters, force majeure events, or any other circumstance beyond its reasonable control.

Should operational requirements or unforeseen circumstances make changes necessary, Magnificent Travel reserves the right to substitute hotels, transportation, sightseeing arrangements, guides, or other services with alternatives of comparable standard without prior notice.

Any additional expenses resulting from such changes, including accommodation, meals, transportation, visa costs, or personal expenses, shall be the sole responsibility of the traveler unless otherwise required by applicable law.
Magnificent Travel accepts no responsibility for the loss, theft, or damage of luggage, travel documents, personal belongings, or valuables during the course of the trip.
Participation in optional activities is entirely at the traveler's own risk.
By confirming a reservation, each traveler acknowledges that they have read, understood, and accepted these Terms & Conditions and agrees to be bound by them.
